AIChatApp Model Reference

- The active offline model is configured by LocalModel:FileName in the API configuration.
- The current default local model is qwen2.5-3b-instruct-q4_k_m.gguf.
- Model files are expected under AIChatApp.Core/Models.
- The API loads the configured GGUF model through LLamaSharp at startup.
- Changing the configured model file changes the local model without requiring a code edit.
- qwen2.5-3b-instruct-q4_k_m.gguf is the current performance-focused default.
- meta-llama-3.1-8b-instruct-q4_k_m.gguf is available as a higher-quality but slower option.
